node.title: Re^2: Are defined or // garantee not to autovivify?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I do defined $hashtest{abc} and $hashtest{abc} because I want the false condition to be based on more than $hashtest{abc} being undef.

In that case, simply using $hashtest{abc} in boolean context is enough to cover undef as well. (Personally I'd add the [doc://defined] test if I'm going to be using an operator that will give me a warning when used with an undef value.)

I would not use the mere existence of the key to mean anything

The difference between [doc://defined] and [doc://exists] becomes quite significant if one iterates over the hash ([doc://keys], [doc://values], [doc://each]).
